items.name: Welcome to Kronos Black Ops 7
items.author: Kronos
items.description: Mods for Kronos show up here. Install them in one click and turn them on or off from the Library.

items.name: Boss Auto-Start
items.author: Ares
items.description: Skips the main Easter egg to the boss fight when your Zombies match reaches round 5. Change the round in kronos/boss_auto_cfg/settings.json.

items.name: Blood Burner
items.author: Shlogbobble
items.description: Endgame's Blood Burner bike as a Zombies field upgrade: summon your own bike and run zombies down to charge its Aether Pulse, which shocks nearby zombies and drops a live LT53 Kazimir. Left alone, it lures zombies in and explodes. Works on every map. On Ashes of the Damned it smashes the wooden barriers like Tessie, rams Veytherion and carries his aetheric energy. Ashes also hides a Blood Burner at Exit 115: find its key and feed it 50 souls to wake it, and one waits in the boss arena too.

items.name: Random Perk Spawns
items.author: Spence
items.description: Randomizes perk machine locations every game on all maps except Paradox Junction and Dead Ops Arcade.

items.name: Cursed Reimagined
items.author: MeowRaK
items.description: Classic-inspired BO7 Zombies overhaul with combined PaP and rarity progression, Green wall-buys and Mystery Box weapons, random Ammo Mods, classic melee, custom armor, and fixed Field Upgrade recharge requirements. For more information, visit the GitHub repository: https://github.com/MeowRaK/bo7-cursed-reimagined

items.name: Mock Multiplayer Matchmaking
items.author: Maverick
items.description: Find a Match and Quick Play start offline matches against bots, with a map vote between matches. Matches keep rolling until you leave the lobby.

items.name: BO7 - World Builder
items.author: ZMRev
items.description: Build your own version of any map. Press F8 to spawn props, machines and zombies, move or delete what's already there, change the sky, and save your layout to load again later.

items.name: disable omni movement
items.author: grum_sudo
items.description: Disables omni-movement and tac sprint

items.name: bo3 health system
items.author: grum_sudo
items.description: restores black ops 3 health system: 3 hit down with no jugg 5 hit down with jugg. disables armor system ,jug augments, super sprinter zombies, and armoured zombies. and also rampage inducer enables super sprinters

items.name: Directed Unlocked
items.author: Max
items.description: Directed Mode without the round cap: quest guidance stays, rounds keep going and the Round-Cap display is hidden. Turn the mod off for the original Directed.

items.name: FuzMenu
items.author: Fuzion28
items.description: Solo Zombies mod menu: god mode, teleports, any weapon or wonder weapon, Pack-a-Punch, perks, gobblegums, rounds, zombies, saved weapon builds and more. Open with Aim + Melee.

items.name: First Box Patch All Maps & BO3 Raygun Mark II Damage
items.author: vexygottaproblem
items.description: Through round 15, the first three box purchases offer Mark II, the supported map's wonder weapon, then native Kazimir equipment. Mark II base damage is 2,000 per projectile or 3,500 upgraded, before native modifiers; unsupported or missing rewards fall back to normal rolls and upgraded Endgame skill mode keeps native damage.

items.name: Enhanced Full Power / Death Machine
items.author: tw13
items.description: Full Power power-ups work exactly as normal, and on top of that the player who picks one up is given a random score streak, straight into their streak slot. Weapon streaks (Death Machine, War Machine...) come with full ammo. Item streaks (RC-XD, DAWG, Toma Strike...) work too. Configurable between all weapon streaks, just death machine, all weapons and item streaks. If you're already holding a streak, the new one replaces it. You can choose to have your old one dropped at your feet instead of lost.

items.name: Restart Hotkey
items.author: Max
items.description: Instantly restarts the current Zombies match (fast restart, back to round 1): press Interact (F) and Melee (V) at the same time. Host only.

items.name: Cursed Reimagined - BO3 Health Compatible
items.author: MeowRaK
items.description: BO3 Health-compatible edition of Cursed Reimagined featuring combined PaP and rarity progression, Green wall-buys and Mystery Box weapons, random Ammo Mods, classic melee, and fixed Field Upgrade recharge. Requires standalone BO3 Health, installed separately.

items.name: PhD Tribologist Buffed
items.author: Trinity
items.description: Buffs PhD Flopper's Tribologist augment: no 3 second cooldown between slide boosts, a stronger boost, and a higher speed cap. Only affects players with Tribologist equipped.

items.name: Fast Restart
items.author: Tinhorn
items.description: Old-CoD fast restart in any Zombies match. Crouch, then pause: Save & Quit becomes Fast Restart. Pause standing for the normal Save & Quit.

items.name: Aether Blade Lethal
items.author: Shlogbobble
items.description: Endgame's Aether Blade as its own Zombies lethal. Pick AETHER BLADE next to the Combat Axe in your loadout: throw it and it homes in on the nearest zombie, chains through up to 7 of them, then flies back to you and refills after 3 seconds. You can also craft it at the crafting bench (Lethal tab, 4000 salvage), get it from the Mystery Box, and swapping it for another lethal drops it on the ground for anyone to pick up. Its kills count toward the Combat Axe T.E.D.D. trial. Works on every map.

items.name: Perk Remove
items.author: Kazuto
items.description: Remove any perk you own at its own machine (Press F / X). No refunds, Eternal perks stay. Standard, Cursed and Mister Peeks Mayhem. Works with Classic Perks.

items.name: XP HUD Overlay
items.author: ripsawuk
items.description: XP HUD Overlay v1.0. Provides a visible overlay on your HUD to show you live XP being earned in game. Various customisation options that can be changed in game from positioning, to colours, to bar types (cats??). Dont like the bar? Disable it. Use the text only. Dont like the text? Disable it, use the bar only. Adjust to your liking. Currently only captures operator levelling and XP.

items.name: Phantom Menu
items.author: Ares
items.description: Zombies mod menu: spawn enemies and guns, Pack-a-Punch, rounds, power-ups, Forge, Boss Creator, Map Rotation, presets and more. Solo / private matches only.
